name: Emerald Fathoms
image_style: A layered cut-paper diorama lit from behind like a kirigami light box: overlapping planes of translucent vellum and thin emerald and silver foil create real physical depth, with visible paper edges, soft internal glow, and delicate silhouette detailing rather than painterly brushwork. The mood is hushed, ambitious, and subaqueous, as if the whole scene sits just under a lake's surface. Palette: deep bottle-black and near-black emerald grounds, cold jade and bottle-green midtones, tarnished silver highlights, and small glints of phosphor-green light; avoid warm gold, crimson, or any bright non-green accent. Keep compositions spacious and dim along the top, with one calm low-light region reserved for desktop widgets. Landscape only, no lettering, logos, watermarks, or frames.
scene: A vast subterranean common room beneath a black lake, its arched stone windows glowing with murky jade light as unhurried fish and one curious giant squid tentacle drift past outside. Carved serpent motifs coil along dark wood furniture and tall iron sconces; a crackling green-tinted fire throws long shadows across cold flagstones and a long polished table set with silver-rimmed goblets. Ambitious young witches and wizards in trimmed black robes huddle over unrolled parchment maps and a ticking silver hourglass, plotting with quiet intensity. Space Ghost sits stiffly at the head of the table in his unmistakable muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, and red power bands, gravely holding a small kitchen egg-timer aloft as though it were the house's legendary points glass, completely convinced of his authority. No one at the table looks up. Keep the vaulted stone ceiling and upper archways quiet, dim, and largely empty for a desktop panel, with a calm shadowed region at the right for widgets. No lettering, legible crest text, logos, watermark, or frame.
